rationale: Trend, structure (3.09 retail-long), macro risk-off and unlock overhang all favor shorts, but spot 7.174 sits only ~0.8% above support 7.117 with 1d RSI at a deeply oversold 19.4 — shorting into the floor offers terrible at-market R:R (~0.06 risk to support vs ~6% bounce-back to resistance 7.497) and elevated mean-reversion/short-squeeze risk on any BTC bounce. The honest play is to wait for a relief bounce toward 7.40-7.50 to short strength rather than chase lows; with funding negative and OI already deleveraged, there's no long froth to fade and limited crash fuel. No long here either — high BTC-beta (0.894) in a downtrend makes catching the oversold bounce a low-quality coin-flip.
